svg.text: UML component diagram. Fill colour is the component's role; connector notation is defined in the legend.
binds LISTEN_PORT, runs the Rx thread;
the intra-ego R2 edge — fire and forget
the R8 FSM, the fault plans
four stages on the Rx thread;
confidences, F1 sender speed, and the
field is emitted as null, never omitted
byte-synced R1 content and R2 copies
both clock stamps, the stage counters;
and the base64 pcap export blocks
capture in the background, then exec
the R7 gate: no transport header
Dashed open arrow — a «use» dependency between components.
Solid triangle — realization: the component implements the interface above it.
A rounded navy frame is this node; a grey frame is a node outside it.
A dashed component is test equipment standing in for a real node.
